tabNotice: Choosing a tab does not send a question or load new guidance.
helpNotice: For a question to AI, review the question and attachments below, then choose Send. The urgent contact options above remain available.
guideNotice: Read guidance prepared by this service. This action does not ask AI or send your question, profile, or care records.
safetyNotice: Read this service's prepared safety information. This action does not ask AI or send your question, profile, or care records.
guideError: The guidance could not be loaded. You can try again; any guidance already shown remains available.
cachedGuide: Prepared guidance in {{language}} · kept during this login
question: Your question
inputHint: Enter adds a new line. The Send button sends your question. Inputs stay here during this login when you leave night mode; refreshing or signing out clears them.
replaceQuestion: Replace your current question with this example?
clearQuestionConfirm: Clear the question you have written? This does not cancel a question already sent.
previewNotice: This is the question and attachment choice for this request. Changing them or the language requires confirmation again.
profileIncluded: Attach the profile fields used by this service
recordsExcluded: Do not attach care, mood, or recovery records
nightStyle: Request a shorter night mode answer
retryHelp: Send this question to AI again
sending: Waiting for an AI answer. You can return to the app; this request will stay in progress during this login.
sendFailed: An answer could not be obtained. Your question is still here.
sendUnconfirmed: An answer could not be confirmed. The service may have processed the earlier question; your input is still here.
failedQuestion: Question and choices used in the unsuccessful request
previousAnswer: This is the earlier answer. It does not answer the request above.
retryConsent: Review the current question and confirm again before retrying. Retry sends a new AI request; it does not check or restore the earlier answer.
resultReady: A night mode AI answer is ready to review.
replaceUnread: Send a new question? If a new answer arrives, it will replace the answer you have not yet reviewed.
sentQuestion: Question and choices used for this answer
closeAnswerConfirm: Close this answer? It is kept only during this login and cannot be reopened after closing.
workSending: Waiting for a night mode answer
workResult: Night mode answer ready to review
